An open foundation. A personal direction.

A small lamp for your digital life.

Our proposed product is a user-owned personal agent workspace. The first customer is an individual who uses several AI tools and keeps rebuilding the same preferences, notes and project context.

Local-first context, a permissioned runtime and inspectable task checkpoints are the intended foundation. CockroachDB-backed synchronization is a planned option for durable cross-device state, not a service running behind this page. Provider compatibility, encryption and recovery still need implementation and verification.

Inspect this website on GitHub ↗

Can I use the new workspace today?

This page is a concept preview. The earlier writing-engine experiments are separate work, not a delivered personal agent runtime. You can request early access to shape a bounded first pilot.

Why use this alongside my AI tools?

The proposed job is keeping your chosen context and unfinished work portable, with explicit permission boundaries. Personal assistants and memory products already exist; we must prove this workflow is easier and worth paying for.

What will it cost?

The managed product will require payment before use. Pilot scope, provider usage, limits and price will be agreed before payment. There is no checkout or automatic charge on this page.

Is the new runtime open source already?

No. Open-source release of the proposed runtime is part of the direction, not an available download. The website source is public. Compatibility, security and real task recovery are not established by this illustration.
